data.exact_reserve_text: During the year there was net adverse claims development of GBP 34.5 million on the 2013 and prior years and GBP 1.3 million on the 2014 year of account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reserve strengthening following independent claims review
prior_year_events.impact_description: Independent claims review led to material strengthening of claims reserves, particularly on professional indemnity, Directors & Officers and medical malpractice (2013 and prior underwriting years).

data.standardized_narrative: During 2015 the Managing Agent and independent claims consultants reviewed open claims and materially strengthened claims reserves. The gross prior-year (2013 & prior) provision was increased by GBP 71.18m (a strengthening), driven principally by adverse development on professional indemnity, Directors & Officers and medical malpractice business; the report also states a net adverse development of GBP 34.5m on 2013 & prior (net of reinsurance).
raw_causal_phrases: claims reserves were strengthened materially, in particular on the 2013 and prior years
significant increase in the incurred claims position on the professional indemnity, Directors and Officers and medical malpractice classes of business
net adverse claims development of GBP 34.5 million on the 2013 and prior years and GBP 1.3 million on the 2014 year of account

The gross figure (71.18m) was taken from the Technical Provisions movement table; the narrative net figure is noted but not used as the primary prior-year gross movement.
